verdicts.reason: Both candidates have the same flaws. The Fizzbang can, which is key product imagery, is shrunk to an illegible thumbnail stuck to the bottom-left next to a tiny logo pill. That leaves a cramped footer cluster beside an empty bottom-right corner. Both CTAs are also slightly out of line with the text column's left edge. A's wider CTA holds the hierarchy better, while B's narrower, centred button is weaker and floats more arbitrarily, so A is marginally better.
